metadata.description: Three production-grade design skills (impeccable, design-taste-frontend, emil-design-eng) stacked into one composable Claude Code plugin, plus a fourth (houdini) for the cold-start blank canvas. Includes the nanogen MCP server for Gemini image generation and an eight-family palette state machine with prose-to-OKLCH translation.

plugins.name: presto
plugins.description: Design plugin. /magic runs the full 9-phase flow (Houdini→Read→Context→Dials→Stack→Build→Polish→Audit→Finalize) with five modes (--surprise, default, --guided, --nohoudini, --use). /houdini fills the blank canvas with real starter HTML and auto-detects user-provided refs in seeds/. Ten standalone break-out commands (including /imagen, /imagen-edit, /set-palette, /palette-status). The --palette flag accepts five input shapes: family key, none, inline OKLCH, positional OKLCH, or plain English prose that a translator agent maps to OKLCH with impeccable bans enforced. Nanogen MCP server bundled at mcp-servers/nanogen/. Per-run archive at outputs/<slug>/.
